name: encrypt-provider
description: Runtime protected-content encrypt/seal boundary: generates CEK+KID in-boundary and emits only ciphertext + non-secret relatives
author: elastos

authority.reason: Owns content-encryption-key generation and sealing for protected content. The raw CEK and the plaintext asset are generated and consumed entirely inside this boundary; callers receive only ciphertext, KID, IV, and a wrapped (sealed) CEK. No app capsule ever receives a raw CEK, the plaintext asset, KMS credentials, chain RPC, or wallet RPC.
